system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each turn begins by building the model input from the user request, system instructions, conversation history, available tool schemas, relevant memory, plan state, and host-provided constraints.
system_prompt_style.note: SystemPromptBuilder imported in agentao/agent.py; AGENTAO.md project instructions and date context injected per docs.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: File tools inspect, create, or modify local artifacts. Shell tools execute commands within the configured working directory and optional sandbox. Search tools provide repository and content search.
env_context_strategy.note: Memory recall and AGENTAO.md injection also add context; the instance template itself was not in the evidence.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Token tracking, LLM-summarized compaction, overflow recovery, file re-injection
context_compaction.note: The paper says the sanitize phase 'redact[s] or normalizes outputs'. Per-observation truncation code was not visible in the evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the formatting phase converts tool results into model-readable messages

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: This design preserves compatibility with strict tool-calling APIs that require every assistant tool call to receive a corresponding tool result.

tool_count.note: The tool registry (register_builtin_tools) was truncated from the evidence. Tool categories are listed but not counted.

edit_primitive.note: The file_ops tool definition was not in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The runtime can namespace externally derived tools, translate protocol schemas into model-visible tool schemas
tool_schema_source.note: The built-in tool schema source was not visible in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP (stdio / Streamable HTTP / SSE) for tools · ACP (stdio JSON-RPC) for full agents · plugin lifecycle

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The runner constructs model context, invokes the LLM client through a provider-neutral interface, receives assistant messages and tool-call proposals, and delegates executable actions to the tool runner.
loop_primitives.note: event_driven is based on the host EventStream and transport events.

multi_agent_topology.note: Built-in and custom sub-agents are reachable (orchestrator_workers). The CLI factory may enable them; exact line not given.

delegation_mechanism.note: subagent_spawn is reachable via the agent tools and .agentao/agents/*.md definitions.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: A session contains conversation state, task metadata, active permissions, memory references, and replay pointers.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: SQLite-backed persistent memory with two scopes (user / project), automatic recall, jieba 中文 segmentation
long_term_memory.note: No enum value fits a SQLite memory store exactly; episodic_db is the closest. Skills are loaded from skills/.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: This allows long-running work to be paused, resumed, inspected, or embedded into host applications

self_verification.note: No verification config surface is visible in the evidence.

retry_policy.note: The run loop code was truncated. The paper leaves retries to the scheduler.

rollback.note: The file tool definitions were not in the evidence.

termination_condition.note: max_steps comes from the loop bound K_max / max_iterations. The on_max_iterations_callback parameter is in agent.py.

cost_controls.note: No cost config was visible in the evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Shell tools execute commands within the configured working directory and optional sandbox.
execution_isolation.note: macOS sandbox-exec is optional; the sandbox_policy parameter defaults to None.

filesystem_access.note: Scoping is relative to the host. Default mode appears to be workspace-write.

network_policy.evidence_quote: prompt for broad shell or network actions
network_policy.note: Network actions are gated by prompt rather than blocked.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The policyP is composed from multiple sources: hardline safety checks, per-run restrictions, user or host rules, permission-mode presets, and tool-level defaults.

replayability.evidence_quote: Replay is implemented as an append-only event timeline.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Pre-tool hooks can deny a proposed action, downgrade an allowed action to confirmation, or inject project-specific restrictions.
guardrails.note: output_filters: the sanitize phase redacts outputs. input_filters: prompt hooks exist, but whether they can block input is uncertain.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Agentao shares the concern for local files and shell-mediated actions, but generalizes beyond coding tasks.

open_source.evidence_quote: Open source. Use and modify as needed.
open_source.note: The LICENSE file was not in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: For Anthropic / Gemini / DeepSeek / any OpenAI-compatible provider
